events.headline: Oil trades near six-month highs (Brent ~$111-115, WTI ~$100) as the Iran war continues to disrupt flows through the Strait of Hormuz and a September 11 strike on the Saudi East-West pipeline keeps supply risk elevated; OPEC+ output remains well below targets per IEA's October report
Nvidia, AMD and Intel shares retreated again in late-October trading as AI-capex/debt financing fears and losses among Asian chip suppliers weighed on the sector's recovery

TSMC is surveying suppliers for rare-earth-free factory-automation equipment as China's rare-earth/battery-material export-control suspension (in place since Nov 2025) is set to expire November 10, 2026, raising the prospect of renewed curbs on chip-supply-chain inputs
Markets price roughly 90% odds the Fed holds its benchmark rate at 3.75%-4.00% at the October 27-28 FOMC meeting, with officials striking a cautious/hawkish tone and little chance of a near-term cut
